Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"You plan everything except this"

Hook
"You'd never run your career without a plan. So why are you dating without one?" (to camera, close framing)
Body
"I've coached 1,200+ women toward healthy love, and the ambitious ones almost always have the same gap. They're brilliant at everything else, but in dating they're guessing. Once you know your non-negotiables and what to look for on a first date, it gets a lot simpler." (cut to workbook on a desk)
CTA
"I put the whole first step into a 7-day program called The Dating Reset. Tap Learn more to start today."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions for a first date"

Hook
"Three questions I'd want every woman I coach to ask herself after a first date." (walking, natural light)
Body
"One: did he ask about my life, or just talk about his? Two: did his words and his plans match? Three: how did I feel when I left, calm or anxious?" (on-screen text for each question)
CTA
"There are 25 more like this in my First Date Filter, and the full method is in The Dating Reset. Link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where should I start?"

Hook
"Women ask me where to start if they're not ready for one-to-one coaching. Here's my honest answer." (sitting, relaxed, to camera)
Body
"Start with seven days. One short lesson a day: your pattern, your non-negotiables, chemistry versus compatibility, your profile, first dates, pace, and your plan. By day seven you'll know exactly what you're looking for."
CTA
"It's called The Dating Reset, and you can start today. Tap Learn more."
